emitTokenRebase(uint256,uint256,uint256,.details: these events are used to calculate protocol gross (without protocol fees deducted) and net APR (StETH APR)     *      preShareRate = preTotalEther * 1e27 / preTotalShares     postShareRate = postTotalEther * 1e27 / postTotalShares     NET_APR = SECONDS_IN_YEAR * ((postShareRate - preShareRate) / preShareRate) / timeElapsed     postShareRateNoFees = postInternalEther * 1e27 / (postInternalShares - sharesMintedAsFees)     GROSS_APR = SECONDS_IN_YEAR * (postShareRateNoFees - preShareRate) / preShareRate / timeElapsed

params._postInternalEther: the total amount of internal ether after the oracle tx
params._postInternalShares: the total number of internal shares after the oracle report tx
params._postTotalEther: the total amount of ether after the oracle report tx
params._postTotalShares: the total number of shares after the oracle report tx
params._preTotalEther: the total amount of ether before the oracle report tx
params._preTotalShares: the total number of shares before the oracle report tx
params._reportTimestamp: timestamp of the refSlot block for the report applied
params._sharesMintedAsFees: the number of shares minted to pay fees to Lido and StakingModules
params._timeElapsed: seconds since the previous applied report

params._depositsReserveTarget: initial value for deposits reserve target (in wei)
